entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fatemeh Pahlavi was an Iranian princess of the Pahlavi dynasty. She was the tenth child of Reza Shah and the half-sister of Mohammad Reza Pahlavi. Born in Tehran, she left Iran prior to the Islamic Revolution in 1979. Pahlavi died of cancer in London in 1987.
